ref.description: Dotted path into the scriptConfig (e.g. 'basic.fishGuttingItem'). The admin UI walks the path to find the current item name.

label.description: Display label shown in the Misc tab, e.g. 'Fish Knife'. Independent of the configured item name so admins who rename an item to 'my_knife' still see 'Fish Knife' in the panel.

fishMeatItem.description: Universal meat item granted by gutting (cut AND crush minigames — fish, crustaceans, turtles all output this). Each cut carries metadata (fishId, fishLabel, fishWeight, rawWeight) so the same item works for every species without needing per-fish meat items in your items.lua. Override per-fish via the fish's `fishMeatItemOverride` field if you want a specific named item for a specific species.

x-installItem.label: Fish Meat
x-installItem.description: Fresh fish or crustacean meat. Check the metadata to see which species it came from.

gutting.description: Fish-gutting tunables: cut weight scaling, minigame difficulty, random reward pool.

useMinigame.description: Show the cutting minigame when a player guts a fish. Disable for a silent skill-only flow.

toolsBreak.description: When on, the fish knife and meat mallet consume one use per cut/crush and break (item removed from inventory) at 0. Off for infinite-use tools — flip on for a grindier gameplay loop.

fishKnifeUses.description: Total cuts a fresh fish knife can perform before breaking. Only applies when 'toolsBreak' is on.

meatMalletUses.description: Total crushes a fresh meat mallet can perform before breaking. Only applies when 'toolsBreak' is on.

sellMeat.description: Allow players to sell filleted/gutted meat at the fish market (priced off the source species).

meatSellBonus.description: Flat price multiplier on the source species’ market price when selling filleted meat. 1.25 = +25% over the raw fish per-kg price.

minWeightFraction.description: Fraction of the raw fish weight a zero-skill cutter keeps as meat (0–1). Default 0.4 = 40%.

maxWeightFraction.description: Fraction of the raw fish weight a max-skill cutter keeps as meat. Default 0.9 = 90%.

minigameAccuracyWeight.description: How much the minigame accuracy can push the cut yield above the skill baseline. Accuracy is now a strict multiplicative gate — 0% accuracy always yields 0 meat regardless of skill. At 100% accuracy, yield = skillFraction × (1 + minigameAccuracyWeight). Default 0.5 = up to 1.5× the skill yield on a perfect cut. 0 = accuracy still gates 0%, but no upper bonus.

skillEasing.description: How strongly fishing skill softens the minigame (slower pulse, wider sweet-spot tolerance). 0 = species-difficulty only; 1 = high-skill players have a much easier minigame.

rarityHardness.description: How strongly species rarity makes the minigame harder (faster pulse, longer cut path). 0 = same difficulty for every fish; 1 = rare fish are significantly harder to cut cleanly.

cutBuffer.description: How forgiving the cut line is on the gutting minigame. Anywhere within this fraction of the line's tolerance band counts as a PERFECT on-line cut (no accuracy penalty) — only drift past it starts costing. 0 = must trace dead-centre; 0.9 = very forgiving. Default 0.55.

randomRewards.description: Items that may drop on a successful gut. Each fish rolls these independently of the minigame accuracy. Defaults are inspired by the bait-dig random pool but live independently here so admins can tune them per use case.

permitPrice.description: Price of the global fishing permit

permitInterval.description: Global permit duration in hours. 168 = 1 week, 720 = 1 month.

permitAccounts.description: Payment accounts accepted when buying a permit

replacePermitPrice.description: Cost to replace a lost permit card

permitRevokers.description: Map of group name -> minimum grade required to revoke fishing permits via the back-of-card UI when shown in person. Empty object disables in-world revocation.

strictCatchLevel.description: When on, players can only catch fish at or below their fishing level (matches the level required to sell). When off, fish up to 10 levels above the player can still be caught at a reduced rate, but they won't be sellable — leaving players with unsellable inventory. Default on (recommended).

curve.title: Levelling style
curve.description:
The SHAPE of the climb.

Long haul: early levels fly, the last few are a project.
Steady: every level costs the same — predictable, and flat at the top.
Classic RPG: cost grows with the square. A real climb without a cliff.
Reachable: steep early, easing near the top, for a ladder meant to be finished.

Switching takes nobody's XP away. Level is worked out from XP every time it is asked for, so everyone is simply re-read against the new shape.

x-validate.message: Max level is below the starting level

modifier.description: XP curve multiplier. Higher value = slower levelling.

extraXpForRelease.description: Extra XP percentage bonus for releasing a fish instead of keeping it (0–100%)

maxTrapsPerPlayer.description: Maximum number of traps a single player can have placed at once

minTrapDistance.description: Minimum distance (in game units) between any two traps to prevent overcrowding

trapMaxDepth.description: Maximum water depth (in metres) traps can be placed in. Prevents pots being dropped where nothing trappable spawns. Minimum is hardcoded at 2.0m.

trapCatchRate.description: Multiplier on the per-tick catch chance for traps (every 90 seconds). 0.5 = default, 1.0 = same odds as rod fishing, 2.0 = double. Per-tick chance = biteChance × abundance × this value × baitWeight.

trapStaleTimeHours.description: Hours before an unchecked trap is automatically removed (stale). 48 = 2 days.
trapStaleTimeHours.title: Trap Stale Time

showTrapBlips.description: Show map blips on the in-game minimap for the player's own placed traps. Other players' traps are never blipped.

trapPullTimeout.description: Seconds allowed to complete the trap pull minigame before it auto-fails. 0 = no timeout.

chanceOfBreak.description: Base percentage chance (0-100) that a trap will break each fill tick. Actual break chance is: chanceOfBreak * (1 - strength) — and it re-rolls EVERY fill tick, so it compounds over a fill cycle. Keep it low (a strength-0.3 trap at 10% breaks ~7%/tick, which is brutal). 0 = traps never break.

bigFishDifficulty.description: Optional: make heavier individual fish harder to land in the catch minigame. The nibble waves already telegraph a big fish; when enabled, the fight scales by how heavy THIS fish is within its species' weight range (a max-weight trophy is hardest, a runt easiest). Off by default so existing servers are unchanged.

enabled.description: Turn weight-based fight difficulty on. Off = every fish of a species fights the same regardless of weight (original behaviour).

zoneTighten.description: How much smaller the catch good-zone gets for a max-weight fish. 0 = no change, 0.4 = up to 40% narrower.

speedBoost.description: How much faster a max-weight fish darts around. 0 = no change, 0.6 = up to 60% faster.

drainBoost.description: How much faster the catch bar drains while off-target for a max-weight fish. 0 = no change, 0.5 = up to 50% harsher.

stockResetIntervalSeconds.description: How often equipment store stock is restocked. Only applies to items with maxStock set; unlimited items are unaffected.
stockResetIntervalSeconds.title: Stock Reset Interval

keysWhileFishing.description: GTA control IDs that stay usable while fishing / placing traps. The rod UI normally disables every control, which also blocks voice. 249 = push-to-talk. Add more control IDs as needed — see https://docs.fivem.net/docs/game-references/controls/.

disableBuiltInShop.description: Hide the built-in store-ped interactions (Open Store / Buy Equipment and Sell Bait) so you can use your own shop system. Manage Permit and Get Guidebook stay available. If a fishMarket ped has nothing left to offer, its interaction is skipped entirely.

disablePermits.description: Master switch: turn off the ENTIRE permit/licence system in one go — the global market licence, per-zone and per-fish permits, the store peds' Manage Permit option and permit purchases. Use this when your server runs its own licensing. Overrides every permitRequired flag; no need to edit them individually.

defaultControls.description: The keys fishing actions start on. These are only DEFAULTS the server hands out — each player can rebind any of them for themselves in the pause menu under Settings > Key Bindings > FiveM, and their choice overrides what is set here.

theme.description: Optional per-resource theme override. When useOverride is on, dirk_fishing's NUIs use these values instead of the global dirk_lib theme. Mirrors the dirk_lib appearance fields.

useOverride.description: Off means this script follows the global dirk_lib theme, so every dirk NUI matches. Turn it on only if you want fishing to look different from the rest.

primaryColor.description: Mantine palette name (or 'custom' to use the customTheme stops).

primaryShade.description: Shade index 0-9 within the active palette.

access.description: Who (besides server admins) can open & edit this script's live config — additive on top of dirk_lib's master admins (the dirk_lib_master_group convar), never removes their access. Enforced SERVER-SIDE by dirk_lib. x-serverOnly so the grant list never leaves the server — it's stripped from client snapshots and only the editing admin ever sees it.

groups.description: Job / gang / ACE group names granted config-edit access (checked via IsPlayerAceAllowed).

identifiers.description: Specific players granted access — stored as the framework persistent id (citizenid on qb/qbx, license on esx). dirk_lib also matches raw FiveM identifiers (license:/discord:/...).

seaBoundary.description: Polygon defining the salt/fresh water boundary. Points inside = fresh water.

tournaments.description: Fishing tournaments. Admins configure schedule, entry, scoring and prizes; server handles signup, tracking and payout.

scoring.description: Weight: heaviest single fish per player. Count: most fish caught. Total Weight: highest combined weight of all catches.

fish.description: Species that count toward this tournament. Empty = any species.

location.description: Optional fishing zone name. Leave blank for any location.

prizeMode.description: fixed: admin sets prizePool directly. pot: prizePool = entryFee * participants, built from signups.

prizePool.description: Prize pool in dollars (fixed mode) or starting pool (pot mode, usually 0).

prizeSplit.description: Payout percentages for 1st, 2nd, 3rd... places. Must sum to 100. Collapses if fewer scorers than slots.

entryFee.description: Signup fee in dollars. Set to 0 for free tournaments.

x-validate.message: Minimum entrants is above the maximum

minParticipants.description: Minimum signups required at start. Below this, tournament cancels and fees are refunded.

allowLateJoin.description: If enabled, players can sign up after the tournament has started (any time before it ends) instead of only while it's upcoming. The end time stays the same for everyone.

startsAt.description: Unix ms timestamp of start (one-off tournaments).

endsAt.description: Unix ms timestamp of end (one-off tournaments).

recurring.description: Optional recurring schedule. If set, startsAt/endsAt are recomputed each cycle.

dailyChallenges.description: Daily challenges. Each player is rolled one challenge per day, filtered by their level. Progress tracks on fish caught; rewards pay out on claim.

enabled.description: Toggle the daily challenge feature on/off.

resetHour.description: Server-local hour at which daily challenges reset (0 = midnight).
resetHour.title: Reset At

rewardMultiplier.description: Global multiplier applied to all challenge rewards (xp and money).

templates.description: Challenge templates. A daily roll picks one template whose level band includes the player's level, then rolls a specific target within that template.

label.description: Display label. Use {target} and {fish} as placeholders.

type.description: Challenge type. catch_count: any N fish. catch_species: N of one randomly-picked species from fishPool. catch_weight: total weight in grams.

x-validate.message: Min level is above the max level

minLevel.description: Minimum player level for this template to be eligible.

maxLevel.description: Maximum player level for this template to be eligible.

x-validate.message: Target min is above the target max

fishPool.description: Which fish a catch_species challenge picks from. Your fish are sorted by Info Unlock Level and split into three equal groups, so a band is never empty and stays balanced as you add fish. Ignored by catch_count and catch_weight.

logging.description: What fishing reports. Webhooks, filters and retention moved to /dirk_config > Logs, so one place configures every script instead of each one carrying its own copy.

enabled.description: Report fishing events to dirk_lib's logging. Where they GO - the Logs page, Discord webhooks, an external service - is set once in /dirk_config > Logs and applies to every dirk script.

suspiciousSaleThreshold.description: If a single sale pays out more than this amount, the log entry is flagged with a warning (anti-exploit). 0 disables flagging.

x-pages.label: Players
